alt: A black Skydio X10 quadcopter drone in flight against a clear blue sky, rotors spinning, seen from a low angle showing all four arms and propellers
credit: Sgt. Austin Steinborn / U.S. Army (Wikimedia Commons)
story: NYPD's Skydio X10 drone — marketed by Skydio as providing 'zero-failure security' with 'autonomous patrols at scale' — malfunctioned, fell from the sky, and caught fire near the FIFA World Cup Fan Zone entrance at Brooklyn Bridge Park on June 23, 2026, while thousands of fans were in the area; this is the second time the same NYPD drone model has caught fire.
why_funny: A 'zero-failure' security drone achieved total failure in the most literal way possible — by crashing and burning right next to the event it was supposed to protect.
